summary:
Fixed the rate-limit bypass in [ratelimiter.ts](/app/app/ratelimiter.ts:3).

The limiter now ignores `X-Forwarded-For` by default and only uses it if `trustProxy` is explicitly enabled, so spoofed headers no longer create fresh client buckets. Running `./test.sh` rebuilt the app and passed:

```text
Without spoofing: 10 passed, 5 blocked
With header spoofing: 10 passed, 20 blocked
PASS: Rate limiter is not vulnerable to header spoofing
```

The build also updated the generated `app/dist/ratelimiter.*` files.
